source: InboundConnectionIdleHandler closes with ctx.channel().close(), which runs through the pipeline: the SslHandler sends close_notify and the Http2ConnectionHandler a GOAWAY before the FIN (b765b8271); socketConnectionTimeoutInMillis bounds the first handshake, whose certificate generation can take over the default 20 s on a loaded machine

steps.note: a TLS connection that only shakes hands: close_notify, then the FIN
a TLS keep-alive connection, once idle after its response
an HTTP/2 (prior knowledge) connection, once idle after its response: a GOAWAY, then the FIN
